image_datasets.name: GenImage: A Million-Scale Benchmark for Image Generation Detection

labels.1: Synthetic (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion v1.4/v1.5/v2.1, SDXL, GLIDE, VQDM, Wukong, ADM)

limitations: Synthetic images generated from fixed ImageNet class prompts; does not cover multi-subject narrative compositions.
Early diffusion models over-represented; requires supplement for newest flow-matching architectures (Flux, SD3).
image_datasets.leakage_prevention: Strict ImageNet synset class-level partitioning between train and test splits. Zero prompt overlap across splits.
image_datasets.balancing_strategy: 1:1 real-to-synthetic ratio maintained across every generator subset.

image_datasets.name: CIFAKE: Real and AI-Generated Synthetic Images
image_datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0
limitations: Low spatial resolution (32x32) limits microscopic sensor noise analysis.
Single generator model (Stable Diffusion v1.4 only).
image_datasets.leakage_prevention: Separate official train (100k) and test (20k) sets with verified zero image overlap.

image_datasets.name: FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images
image_datasets.format: H.264 video frames and lossless PNG face extractions

labels.0: Original / Pristine YouTube facial video frames

limitations: Face manipulation specific; does not evaluate full-scene diffusion models.
Compression artifacts (C23 raw vs C40 heavy) can act as spurious shortcut features if unnormalized.
image_datasets.leakage_prevention: Actor/video-level separation (720 train, 140 val, 140 test videos). Frames from the same video are strictly forbidden from spanning train and test.
image_datasets.balancing_strategy: Equalized frame sampling across original and 5 manipulation methodologies.

image_datasets.name: Celeb-DF (v2): Large-scale Challenging Deepfake Dataset

labels.1: High-quality deepfake face swaps generated with improved synthesis

limitations: Imbalanced raw ratio (9:1 fake to real); requires subsampling or weighted loss.
Subject matter restricted to celebrity interview lighting and framing.
image_datasets.leakage_prevention: Disjoint celebrity identity splitting: individuals in test videos are unseen during training.
image_datasets.balancing_strategy: Stratified random subsampling of fake videos to match authentic video duration.

image_datasets.name: DeepFake Detection Challenge Dataset (DFDC)
image_datasets.license: DFDC Competition License (Research and Evaluation Permitted)
image_datasets.format: Full HD MP4 video, varied frame rates and ambient lighting

labels.1: Manipulated (Deepfake, GAN, audio swap, face swap)

limitations: Massive storage footprint (>470GB compressed).
Varied video codecs and intentional post-processing perturbations (rotation, noise, compression).
image_datasets.leakage_prevention: Actor-isolated partitioning. Consenting subjects in the evaluation split do not appear in training.
image_datasets.balancing_strategy: Per-actor paired real/synthetic balanced training batches.

voice_datasets.name: ASVspoof 2019: Automatic Speaker Verification Spoofing and Countermeasures
voice_datasets.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By v1.0)

labels.spoof: Synthetic speech (TTS algorithms A01-A06, Voice Conversion A07-A19)

voice_datasets.sample_count: 121,461 audio utterances across Logical Access (LA) and Physical Access (PA)
limitations: Training partition only contains older parametric/concatenative algorithms; neural vocoders (WaveNet/HiFi-GAN) only appear in the evaluation set.
Acoustic room impulse response is uniform across VCTK recordings.
voice_datasets.leakage_prevention: Speaker-disjoint partitioning: zero speaker overlap between training (20 speakers), development (10 speakers), and evaluation (48 speakers).
voice_datasets.balancing_strategy: Subsampling of bonafide utterances to balance 1:4 raw spoofing distribution during metric calculation.

voice_datasets.name: ASVspoof 2021: Deepfake and Logical Access Evaluation
voice_datasets.format: 16kHz FLAC audio with real-world telephony and IP compression (VoIP, MP3, OPUS)

labels.bonafide: Authentic human speech under lossy transmission
labels.spoof: State-of-the-art TTS and neural voice conversion transmitted over realistic channels

voice_datasets.sample_count: 611,829 evaluation utterances across LA, PA, and DF (Deepfake) tracks
limitations: Lossy codec transcoding (AAC, Opus, MP3 at 8-64kbps) can obscure high-frequency vocoder cues.
Labels for evaluation track released as un-blinded research keys.
voice_datasets.leakage_prevention: Evaluates generalization across unseen compression codecs and transmission networks.
voice_datasets.balancing_strategy: Equal error rate (min t-DCF and EER) calculated with standardized prior weights.

voice_datasets.name: WaveFake: A Data Set to Facilitate Audio Deepfake Detection

labels.bonafide: Authentic speech from LJSpeech (English) and JSUT (Japanese)
labels.spoof: Generated via MelGAN, Parallel WaveGAN, Multi-band MelGAN, HiFi-GAN, WaveGlow

limitations: Single-speaker English base (LJSpeech) and Japanese base (JSUT); lack of multi-accent speaker diversity.
Clean studio conditions without realistic background noise.
voice_datasets.leakage_prevention: Sentence/utterance-level disjoint splitting. Zero text prompt overlap between training and testing.
voice_datasets.balancing_strategy: Downsampling synthetic vocoder samples to achieve 1:1 parity with authentic utterances.

voice_datasets.name: FakeAVCeleb: A Novel Audio-Video Multimodal Deepfake Dataset

labels.RealVideo-RealAudio: Authentic human speech and synchronized video
labels.FakeVideo-RealAudio: Facial deepfake with authentic original speech
labels.RealVideo-FakeAudio: Original video with cloned synthetic audio (SV2TTS / Real-Time Voice Cloning)
labels.FakeVideo-FakeAudio: Both visual and vocal deepfake synthesized

voice_datasets.sample_count: 21,566 multimodal clips across 500 ethnic and gender diverse subjects
limitations: Audio synthesis primarily uses SV2TTS; fewer diffusion vocoder samples.
Occasional YouTube background audio cross-talk.
voice_datasets.leakage_prevention: Subject ethnic and speaker demographic isolation between train and evaluation partitions.
voice_datasets.balancing_strategy: Separate evaluation of RealAudio vs FakeAudio subsets.

voice_datasets.name: MLAAD: Multi-Language Audio Anti-Spoofing Dataset

labels.bonafide: Native speakers across 10 global languages (English, German, French, Spanish, Chinese, Arabic, Hindi, Russian, etc.)
labels.spoof: Synthetic speech generated by multilingual neural TTS (VITS, XTTS, ElevenLabs, YourTTS)

voice_datasets.sample_count: 95,000 utterances across diverse accents and acoustic room reverberations
limitations: Variable sampling rates (16kHz to 24kHz) require strict resample preprocessing to prevent bandwidth leakage.
Language-specific phonetic differences can influence spectral centroid baselines.

out_of_distribution_eval_dataset.name: KRYPTX Independent OOD Forensic Evaluation Suite
out_of_distribution_eval_dataset.description: Evaluation set containing samples from AI generators and acoustic conditions deliberately withheld from training data.
adverse_conditions: Heavy social media JPEG compression (Q=50, Q=35)
Acoustic noise injection (White noise, babble noise, telephonic bandpass 300Hz-3.4kHz)
